name: nels
description: Root dev orchestration for the Nels apps. The frontend, admin, and marketing apps stay independent (each keeps its own pnpm-lock.yaml so its Cloudflare Pages build is unaffected); this package only fans a single command out to all three.

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n frontend,admin,marketing -c green,magenta,cyan "pnpm -C frontend dev" "pnpm -C admin dev" "pnpm -C marketing exec vite dev --port 5175"
scripts.install:all: pnpm -C frontend install && pnpm -C admin install && pnpm -C marketing install
